# Disagreement Log — GTH_105

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 105
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 105 | "the son of a harlot" | "the child of a prostitute" | "a bastard" | *shēre mpornē*: literal phrase vs. social consequence |
| 2 | 105 | "Whoever knows" | "Whoever knows" | "The one who knows" | Universal subject phrasing |

**Total disagreements: 2**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "the son of a harlot" (literal Coptic phrase, preserving gender and pejorative term) and "Whoever knows."
